fills.researcher_notes: A Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Ivanovo press release of 4 May 2021 says construction of the Yuryevets branch and gas distribution station is under way, with the route staked out, the operator house foundation laid and pipe being delivered, and completion planned for 2022. The Ivanovo news portal Izvestno of 26 November 2021 says works on the Yuryevets branch began in 2021 and it would be commissioned in 2022. The sheet says proposed, so a status change is staged. Neither page says whether it was finished.

Neftegaz of 19 August 2019, read as a Wayback copy because the live page answers HTTP 468, gives a capacity of 0.612 million cubic meters a day for the branch, a rounding of the same figure the sheet has as 0.61. The sheet value stays.

fills.researcher_notes: Neftegaz of 19 August 2019, read as a Wayback copy, gives 46.49 km, matching the sheet. The Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Ivanovo release of May 2021, also an existing ref, says 46.32 km, so the length was refined during construction. The sheet keeps the figure the design approval gave. A Government of Ivanovo Oblast planning order of 5 August 2016 era (document 107109185, read through the pravo.gov.ru full-text view) gives the Yuryevets branch total length as 46.4718 km, from Puchezh to Yuryevets. The sheet says 46.49 km, so this agrees within rounding. Same document gives an internal diameter of 100 mm and a working pressure of 0.6 MPa, but the diameter cell is not owed this pass.

The Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Ivanovo release of May 2021 says the project is carried out by Gazprom PJSC under its 2021 to 2025 regional gasification program. Neftegaz says Gazprom Mezhregiongaz is carrying it out. Sheet owner Gazprom PJSC stays.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The Gazprom subsidiary release of May 2021 and the Izvestno article of November 2021 both say building was under way in 2021, with commissioning planned for 2022. The sheet still says proposed. No report on completion was found in the cited pages, so construction is staged and a check for the 2022 opening is owed.
